title: Reset local time at a segment transition

linkedQuestions.stem: An LSPB segment starts at global time 5 s, lasts 2 s and uses blend duration 0.3 s at each end; at global times 5.2, 6.0 and 6.8 s, which local times and regions should the runtime selector use?

title: Integrated evaluated generation with fixed-size elitism

linkedQuestions.stem: Trace this declared six-slot GA generation. The selected parents are P1,P2,P3,P4,P4,P6, paired (P1,P3),(P4,P6),(P2,P4); swap the second waypoint in each pair, label children C1…C6 in that order, then change only C1 from [(0,3),(3,4)] to C1′=[(0,3),(3,5)]. Use the source grid and H-then-V decoder with C=L+10N_obs+N_turn and F=1/(1+C). Retain old elite P1 in one slot, then the five lowest-cost evaluated children, breaking equal costs by child number. Which child-cost vector, next population and best fitness result?
